name: Fairfax County Police Public Safety Cadets
what_you_do: Get leadership, ethics and career training for law enforcement. Cadets get basic, advanced and specialized training. They get ride along time with officers. They get a chance to go to national events and skills contests.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 14 to 20 who like the idea of a career in law enforcement. There are four units. They are the Criminal Justice Academy (Chantilly), West Potomac High School, Annandale High School and South Lakes High School.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Costs for uniforms or gear are not stated on the page.
deadline_text: The 2026 First Nighter meetings were Sept 1 to 3, 2026 (one for each unit). The page asks you to fill out an interest form for updates on future First Nighter dates. No deadline for 2027 is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Public Safety Cadets interest form on the page. The page also links an application. It links a waiver. It links a recommendation form. Email fcpdpsc@fairfaxcounty.gov with questions.
notes: An older Fairfax County police page called these units Explorer posts. They had the same unit numbers. That page no longer loads. Ask the cadet email about the current rules, such as citizenship, grades and costs. The page links an application, a waiver and a recommendation form.
